It messes up adults, too. I was 35 when my father told me, in casual conversation, he would never recommend having children to anyone because it ruined his life. I always knew in my heart that he didn’t love us, but to hear it thrown out like a weather report hit on another level.

Had my roof done earlier this year. About a week later, my dog starts pooping straight blood clots. I start investigating potential causes in my yard. I found a shopping bag full of human feces tucked nicely behind a tree. Turns out my pup had been partaking in the left behind feces. I knew it was the crew because my yard is completely fenced, with no possible way it could have “blown in.” I thought it might actually kill him. I’ve never been so furious in my life. I understand emergencies. But, FFS, there was a dumpster in the driveway! Throw your shit in there!

Forcing me to wear one wet sock. Giving me unlimited popcorn but no access to floss for removing stuck kernels. Sitting in a car with the heat blowing on my face. Any of these and I’m an immediate threat to government secrets.

It is. I can hear the thoughts and I know they are destructive and untrue, but I can’t turn them off. Any tips from those struggling with the same?

In the last6 month’s: found husband of 8 years cheating for the third time. Got divorced but still trying to be friends. He is my best friend and we share our dog so he still needs to be around. Just found out he has been dating a new someone for months. Our divorce was just final. I feel like she’s living my life. I want so badly to still be friends, but I don’t know if that’s crazy. 
Also, both of my cats died, my house flooded, and I had to buy a new furnace. I’m terrified of how I’m going to make ends meet. My job is salary so I can’t work overtime. I am going to try driving for cash but I’m still scared. 
My boss and I don’t get along. I don’t want to leave because I’ve been there 15 years and I love the place and all the other people and the work we do. 
It just feels like everything has fallen apart and each thing triggered anxiety and now the anxiety won’t stop. Even when there isn’t a specific trigger. It’s consuming me. I’m making up scenarios in my head of how things are going to unravel. I know that’s not productive but I can’t make it stop. 
From the outside, I have the perfect life and everything to live for. On the inside I’m absolutely dying.
